title: [Prod] DP and cellxgene privacy and ToS links are broken
body:
What:

Currently on both DP and cellxgene, the cookie banner's links go back to DP homepage

Broken link: https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/static/deploy/tos.html
Broken link: https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/static/deploy/privacy.html

Need:

We need to display the pages correctly

TEAM COMMENTS:

1. Timmy: I think the pages are used to serve from cellxgene's server, but I forgot to take that into account when we updated CloudFront cache behaviors, which now only forwards `/d/*` and `/e/*` requests to cellxgene

2. Timmy: Potential solution is to:
a. Add back CloudFront cache behavior to forward all `/static/cellxgene/*` requests to cellxgene Origin
b. Update directory of tos.html and privacy.html to be served from `/static/cellxgene/deploy/*` instead of `/static/deploy/*`, so it matches the cache behavior path pattern above

3. BrianM:
Those files are added as a customization.  It is in single-cell-infra.  They are configured in the 3 config files for hosted-cellxgene.   They are currently copied in the static assets, and there is a URL where we server then from, which is set to `"/static/deploy/tos.html"` and `"/static/deploy/privacy.html"`.

  Those will need to be changed to point to  the new location of the assets from cellxgene.

  Here is the location of the dev config in single-cell-infra:  https://github.com/chanzuckerberg/single-cell-infra/blob/main/terraform/modules/hosted-cellxgene/common/customize-dev/config.yaml
author: Participant 1
